content:
The associator in the bicategory Adj B is docs#CategoryTheory.Bicategory.Adj.Bicategory.associator, which contains Bicategory twice. Ditto for leftUnitor/rightUnitor/whiskerLeft/whiskerRight below it.
It looks intentional to me, but I just wanted to make sure -- is it intentional?
Does anything use these defs directly or can they be inlined into the Bicategory instance below them?
Should they be CategoryTheory.Bicategory.Adj.associator etc instead? (delete the 2nd Bicategory)
One should not use them directly (only via the bicategory instance on Adj).
